column1: # Client-boundary classification — one row per top-level public-client module (src/*/).
# Source of truth for scripts/client-boundary-gate.sh. Lewis edits classifications here.
#   client-local : must stay client-side (local capture / credentials / wallet / execution). KEEP public.
#   infra        : config / types / utils / wire formats. No moat, no security surface. KEEP public.
#   migrating    : moat intelligence with a server-first path already wired + a degraded local fallback.
#   moat-server  : shared intelligence that should run server-side; currently shipping logic in the bundle.
#   review       : verdict pending — needs per-file review before it's safe to call client or moat.
# Every moat-server / migrating / review module MUST have a row in CLIENT-BOUNDARY.debt.tsv.
